body.prompt: Cinematic film still, photorealistic documentary photography, moody teal and amber color grade, shallow depth of field, film grain. Absolutely no text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no readable signs, no watermark. Vertical 9:16 frame; keep the top 25 percent of the frame calm and dark (sky, ceiling or soft blur) with the main subject in the lower 75 percent. Scene: A dark bedroom before dawn, a smartphone glowing on a bedside table next to an alarm clock, a person's hand reaching for it, cold blue light.
